content.text:
I've written the complete Zephyr RTOS application to `submission/main.c`. The application implements all your requirements:

- Uses devicetree aliases `led0` and `sw0` for LED and button
- Configures LED as output (initially off)
- Configures button as input with internal pull-up
- Sets up GPIO interrupt on falling edge (button press)
- Toggles LED in the interrupt callback
- Sleeps forever in main after initialization

The code uses all the specified Zephyr GPIO API functions and includes the required headers.
